query.esql:
FROM billing_cluster_cost_lookup, billing_realized_pool_lookup, cluster_capacity_utilization_lookup, cluster_deployment_contribution_lookup, cluster_tier_and_datastream_contribution_lookup, cluster_datastream_contribution_lookup, cluster_tier_contribution_lookup METADATA _index
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| EVAL day = DATE_TRUNC(1 day, @timestamp)
| STATS n_bill = COUNT(CASE(_index == "billing_cluster_cost_lookup", 1, null)),
        n_pool = COUNT(CASE(_index == "billing_realized_pool_lookup", 1, null)),
        n_util = COUNT(CASE(_index == "cluster_capacity_utilization_lookup", 1, null)),
        n_dep = COUNT(CASE(_index == "cluster_deployment_contribution_lookup", 1, null)),
        n_tds = COUNT(CASE(_index == "cluster_tier_and_datastream_contribution_lookup", 1, null)),
        n_ds = COUNT(CASE(_index == "cluster_datastream_contribution_lookup", 1, null)),
        n_tier = COUNT(CASE(_index == "cluster_tier_contribution_lookup", 1, null))
        BY day
| EVAL Source = ["Bill", "Capacity pool", "Utilization", "Deployment usage", "Tier and data stream usage", "Data stream usage", "Tier usage"]
| MV_EXPAND Source
| EVAL rows = CASE(Source == "Bill", n_bill,
                   Source == "Capacity pool", n_pool,
                   Source == "Utilization", n_util,
                   Source == "Deployment usage", n_dep,
                   Source == "Tier and data stream usage", n_tds,
                   Source == "Data stream usage", n_ds,
                   n_tier)
| EVAL `Has data` = CASE(rows > 0, 1, 0)
| RENAME day AS `@timestamp`
| KEEP `@timestamp`, Source, `Has data`
| SORT `@timestamp` ASC, Source ASC
| LIMIT 5000

| DROP composite_key
| SORT ts DESC
| LIMIT 1
| EVAL conf_written = event.ingested
| EVAL Setting = ["Rate", "Currency", "Validity window", "Indexing weight", "Query weight", "Storage weight", "Utilization memory weight", "Utilization storage weight", "Utilization floor", "Memory cost weight", "Storage cost weight", "Configuration last written"]
| MV_EXPAND Setting
| EVAL Value = CASE(
    Setting == "Rate", TO_STRING(conf_chargeable_unit_rate),
    Setting == "Currency", conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit,
    Setting == "Validity window", CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT("yyyy-MM-dd", conf_start_date), " to ", DATE_FORMAT("yyyy-MM-dd", conf_end_date)),
    Setting == "Indexing weight", TO_STRING(conf_indexing_weight),

params.markdown:
- Figures convert units at your configured rate. They are not an Elastic invoice.
- Credits, discounts, and commitments are absent from the data.
- Efficiency covers deployments that report node statistics only.
- The current UTC day and the current month are incomplete.
- Month-end projection is month-to-date plus a seven-day mean.
- Cost per terabyte is comparable over time. Its level is not a price.

query.esql:
FROM billing_realized_pool_lookup, cluster_deployment_contribution_lookup, cluster_capacity_utilization_lookup METADATA _index
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| EVAL entity = COALESCE(deployment_id, cluster_name)
| EVAL billed = CASE(_index == "billing_realized_pool_lookup", entity, null),
       used = CASE(_index == "cluster_deployment_contribution_lookup", entity, null),
       measured = CASE(_index == "cluster_capacity_utilization_lookup" AND heap_used_pct_p95 IS NOT NULL, entity, null)
| EVAL day = DATE_TRUNC(1 day, @timestamp)
| STATS Billed = COUNT_DISTINCT(billed),
        `With usage` = COUNT_DISTINCT(used),
        `With utilization` = COUNT_DISTINCT(measured) BY day
| RENAME day AS `@timestamp`
| SORT `@timestamp` ASC
| LIMIT 400
